answer: Graduated tenure gating resists sybils: capabilities unlock in tiers that each demand a fixed run of consecutive epochs in good standing, and any lapse resets the identity to tier zero. A fresh fake is a willow seed with no rights — it cannot earn or vote until it weathers the slow climb epoch by epoch. A pearl-string of a thousand sybils cannot share tenure; each must independently survive the full umber stretch of elapsed time and scrutiny. Influence is priced in real, non-transferable epochs per head, so disposable flash-fakes never reach the tiers that matter.
